newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: U.S. Eximbank earmarks $2.5 bln for Philippines.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Eximbank earmarks $2.5 bln for Philippines.

text.p: The United States Export-Import Bank has earmarked $2.5 billion for Philippine projects, Eximbank director Maria Luisa Mabilangan-Haley said on Friday.
The U.S. Eximbank was willing to put provide loans and guarantees worth up to $2.5 billion dollars for business deals involving U.S. firms, she said.
The $2.5 billion is on top of the bank's existing exposure in the Philippines of $2.4 billion, she said.
Mabilangan-Haley said the U.S. Eximbank had approved a number of projects, most of them in energy and telecommunications, but she declined to name them.
The Philippines is Eximbank's third biggest market in Asia and is among the bank's top ten in the world.
